name: The Cumbernauld Law Practice
tagline: Serving all of Cumbernauld and beyond.
about: The Cumbernauld Law Practice was formed on 1st May 2017 through the combination of the two longstanding Cumbernauld based legal practices of Barrowman & Partners and Ian S Smart & Company. The firm offers a full general practice legal service including, if required, both civil and criminal legal aid.

address.note: Ettrick Walk is on the town centre rooftop next to The Carrickstone bar/restaurant.

hours.times: 9:00 am to 1:00 pm and 2:00 pm to 5:00 pm

formIntro: You may contact us by filling in this form any time you need professional support or have any questions.
You can also fill in the form to leave your comments or feedback.
formHelp: Please limit your entry to 100 words.

formConfidentialityNote: Please do not include confidential or sensitive information in your message. In the event that we are representing a party with opposing interests to your own, we may have a duty to disclose any information you provide to our client.
